WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT
    si.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS gb_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS si
    ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY si.healtheval
),
average_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_rate
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
  sr.healtheval,
  sr.total_scancount,
  sr.gb_per_minute,
  sr.gb_per_minute - ar.avg_rate AS rate_minus_average
FROM status_rates AS sr
CROSS JOIN average_rate AS ar
WHERE sr.gb_per_minute > ar.avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: SQLite AVG ignores NULL rates, so statuses with no non-NULL per-scan ratios do not affect the across-status average; if that average is NULL, the comparison returns no rows.
